app_ready: Your Twitch application is ready: your Twitch modules can talk to Twitch.
guide_intro: For your site to talk to Twitch, Twitch asks for an “application” in your name. It is done once, takes 5 minutes, and is free.
guide_1: **1.** Open [dev.twitch.tv/console](https://dev.twitch.tv/console) and log in with your Twitch account. Click “Register Your Application”.
guide_2: **2.** Give it a name (for example your site's name). In the “Redirect URLs” box, paste the address below (“Copy” button), then click “Add”.
copy_label: Address to paste in Twitch's “Redirect URLs” box
guide_4: **4.** Open your application (“Manage”). Copy the “Client ID”, then click “New Secret” and copy the secret. Paste them below, in “Settings of this feature”, and save. That's all: your Twitch modules use it by themselves.
redirect_keep: This address must be in the “Redirect URLs” box of your Twitch application (add it if it is not there yet): it is used when you connect a new account.
redirect_adopted: These addresses are already used by your channels and known to Twitch: keep them too in the “Redirect URLs” box of your Twitch application.
adopted_note: The ID and secret of your Twitch application were carried over from “My Twitch channel”, without typing them again. They are never shown. What you type in the settings always wins.
forgotten: Carried-over application forgotten. Only the settings of this page count now.
accounts_none: No account connected yet. The “Connect my Twitch channel” button is in “My Twitch channel” (and, for the account that answers in the chat, in the Twitch bot).
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this Twitch account? The modules that use it will stop until it is connected again.
disconnected: Account disconnected: Twitch can no longer be read with this permission.
disconnectedOffline: Account disconnected here, but Twitch could not be told. To be sure, remove the access in Twitch (Settings, then Connections).
not_found: This account is no longer connected. Reload the page.
needHttps: Your site's address must start with https:// for Twitch to accept the connection.
cb_invalid: This connection link is no longer valid. Go back to your site's administration and click the connect button again.
